# Components: Overlays

> Plainkit 0.1.0-alpha.1. Generated by scripts/build-skills.mjs from Generated/*.razor, blazor/mappings, generated.manifest.json and core/dist/elements/api.json. Do not edit: change the source and run the generator.

Every component renders its element with the parameters you set as attributes. An attribute that is not a parameter (`id`, `class`, `data-*`, `aria-*`, ...) is put on the element as it is, and a `class` is added to the component's own (`ExtraClass` on a component that lists it). Names are `Pk` plus the tag in PascalCase.

## `PkCommandPalette`

`<pk-command-palette>`: **Command palette** (Overlays). A keyboard-first launcher: Ctrl/Cmd+K opens a dialog with a search field over grouped commands, fuzzy-matched with highlights, recents when the field is empty, arrows and Enter to run.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Enum values | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Open` | `bool` |  | attribute `open` | Whether it is shown |
| `Placeholder` | `string?` |  | attribute `placeholder` | The placeholder setting |
| `RecentsKey` | `string?` |  | attribute `recents-key` | localStorage key; empty disables recents. |
| `NoShortcut` | `bool` |  | attribute `no-shortcut` | Do not bind Ctrl/Cmd+K on the document. |
| `Label` | `string?` |  | attribute `label` | Accessible name of the dialog. |
| `OnOpen` | `EventCallback` |  | event `pk-open` | It opened (the shortcut, show(), or open set by the host). |
| `OnClose` | `EventCallback<PkCloseEventArgs>` |  | event `pk-close` | A close was asked for (Escape, backdrop, the shortcut, hide()) or a command was chosen (reason "select", already closed). Cancelable except for "select": preventDefault keeps it open. |
| `OnSelect` | `EventCallback<PkSelectEventArgs>` |  | event `pk-select` | A command was chosen; navigates to href when it has one and the event is not cancelled. |

**Event args**

| Event | Args class | Fields |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-close` | `PkCloseEventArgs` | Reason: string? |
| `pk-select` | `PkSelectEventArgs` | Value: string?, Item: JsonElement?, Checked: bool?, Id: string? |

## `PkContextMenu`

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Enum values | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Open` | `bool` |  | attribute `open` | Whether the menu is shown. |
| `Disabled` | `bool` |  | attribute `disabled` | Leave the browser menu alone. |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | default slot | The region the menu belongs to. |
| `MenuContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `menu` | pk-menu-item children. |
| `OnSelect` | `EventCallback<PkSelectEventArgs>` |  | event `pk-select` | An item was chosen. |

When you set a named fragment (`MenuContent`), write the body as an explicit `<ChildContent>` tag too: Razor does not allow an implicit body next to a named fragment.

## `PkDialog`

`<pk-dialog>`: **Dialog** (Overlays). A native modal dialog in five sizes with a scrolling body, full screen on a phone; plus confirm, alert and prompt patterns that return a promise. The backdrop never closes it: every dialog offers its own Cancel or Close. Declarative openers: data-open="#id", data-toggle and data-close work without any script (installed when the element connects).

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Enum values | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `IsOpen` | `bool` |  | attribute `open` | Whether it is shown |
| `IsOpenChanged` | `EventCallback<bool>` |  | two-way pair of `IsOpen` | Raised when IsOpen changes (two-way binding: `@bind-IsOpen`). |
| `Title` | `string?` |  | attribute `heading` | The heading setting |
| `HeaderContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `header` | Custom header. |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | default slot | Body. |
| `FooterContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `footer` | Actions. |
| `OnClose` | `EventCallback<PkCloseEventArgs>` |  | event `pk-close` | escape, close button or method. |
| `ShowCloseButton` | `bool` |  | attribute `hide-close` | Hide the header close button (the dialog offers its own Cancel in the footer). False hides the header close button (the opposite of hideClose); give the dialog its own Cancel or Close. |
| `MaxWidthPx` | `int` |  | attribute `max-width` | Card width in pixels before the viewport clamp; 0 keeps the size preset. |
| `Tint` | `PkDialogTint` | `None` `Product` `Archived` | attribute `tint` | A tinted card: product (green wash) or archived (red wash). |

Two-way binding: `@bind-IsOpen`.

When you set a named fragment (`HeaderContent`, `FooterContent`), write the body as an explicit `<ChildContent>` tag too: Razor does not allow an implicit body next to a named fragment.

**Event args**

| Event | Args class | Fields |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-close` | `PkCloseEventArgs` | Reason: string? |

**Not available as parameters** (they do not exist; do not use them)

| Parameter | Why |
|---|---|
| `CloseButtonLabel` | wrapper behaviour, not a property of the element (The element has no prop for the close button text; it draws a cross with a fixed accessible name (hideClose, mapped as ShowCloseButton, removes it).) |
| `FooterAlignEnd` | wrapper behaviour, not a property of the element (The footer is always end-aligned; there is nothing to switch.) |
| `OverFlyout` | wrapper behaviour, not a property of the element (Not needed: a native dialog is in the top layer, above any flyout.) |

Element details (parts, CSS custom properties, methods, accessibility): `pk-dialog` in the `plainkit-sdk` skill.

## `PkDrawer`

`<pk-drawer>`: **Drawer** (Overlays). A panel that slides in from the left, right or bottom over a dimmed page, on a native modal dialog: backdrop, focus trap and Escape come with it. A bottom sheet has a grab handle and swipe-to-close on touch. Declarative openers: data-open="#id", data-toggle and data-close work without any script (installed when the element connects).

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Enum values | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `IsOpen` | `bool` |  | attribute `open` | Whether it is shown |
| `IsOpenChanged` | `EventCallback<bool>` |  | two-way pair of `IsOpen` | Raised when IsOpen changes (two-way binding: `@bind-IsOpen`). |
| `Title` | `string?` |  | attribute `heading` | Title; also the accessible name. |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | default slot | Body. |
| `FooterContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `footer` | Actions. |
| `ActionsContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `actions` | Actions strip under the header (Save, Cancel). |
| `OnClose` | `EventCallback<PkCloseEventArgs>` |  | event `pk-close` | escape, backdrop, close button, swipe or method. |
| `Persistent` | `bool` |  | attribute `persistent` | The backdrop does not close it. |
| `Wide` | `bool` |  | attribute `wide` | A wider panel (up to 70% of the viewport). |
| `Docked` | `bool` |  | attribute `docked` | A non-modal inspector: it sits inside the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the viewport, has no backdrop and no focus trap, and the page behind stays usable. Escape still asks to close. |

Two-way binding: `@bind-IsOpen`.

When you set a named fragment (`FooterContent`, `ActionsContent`), write the body as an explicit `<ChildContent>` tag too: Razor does not allow an implicit body next to a named fragment.

**Event args**

| Event | Args class | Fields |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-close` | `PkCloseEventArgs` | Reason: string? |

**Not available as parameters** (they do not exist; do not use them)

| Parameter | Why |
|---|---|
| `Backdrop` | wrapper behaviour, not a property of the element (The element has no backdrop switch; the backdrop-less inspector is the docked prop, which is the Docked parameter.) |
| `IsLoading` | wrapper behaviour, not a property of the element (The element has no loading state. Wrapping the body in pk-loading-overlay from the component would change the shape of the markup when it toggles and remount the body; wrap ChildContent in PkLoadingOverlay yourself.) |
| `PhoneCards` | wrapper behaviour, not a property of the element (The SDK has no phone card layout for a drawer.) |

Element details (parts, CSS custom properties, methods, accessibility): `pk-drawer` in the `plainkit-sdk` skill.

## `PkDropdown`

`<pk-dropdown>`: **Dropdown menu** (Overlays). A menu opened from a trigger: buttons or links, headers, dividers, checkable items and submenus, with full keyboard support (arrows, Home, End, typeahead, Right/Left for submenus, Escape).

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Enum values | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Open` | `bool` |  | attribute `open` | Whether the menu is shown. |
| `OpenChanged` | `EventCallback<bool>` |  | two-way pair of `Open` | Raised when Open changes (two-way binding: `@bind-Open`). |
| `Placement` | `string?` |  | attribute `placement` | Preferred side. |
| `KeepOpen` | `bool` |  | attribute `keep-open` | Stay open after an item is chosen (multi-select filters). |
| `Mega` | `bool` |  | attribute `mega` | A wide panel whose items flow into columns (navbar mega menu). |
| `TriggerContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `trigger` | The button that opens it. |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | default slot | pk-menu-item children. |
| `OnSelect` | `EventCallback<PkSelectEventArgs>` |  | event `pk-select` | An item was chosen. |
| `OnOpen` | `EventCallback` |  | event `pk-open` | Opened. |
| `OnClose` | `EventCallback<PkCloseEventArgs>` |  | event `pk-close` | Closed. |

Two-way binding: `@bind-Open`.

When you set a named fragment (`TriggerContent`), write the body as an explicit `<ChildContent>` tag too: Razor does not allow an implicit body next to a named fragment.

**Event args**

| Event | Args class | Fields |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-close` | `PkCloseEventArgs` | Reason: string? |
| `pk-select` | `PkSelectEventArgs` | Value: string?, Item: JsonElement?, Checked: bool?, Id: string? |

## `PkPopover`

`<pk-popover>`: **Popover** (Overlays). A small non-modal panel anchored to its trigger with a heading, body and actions; opens on click or hover, flips and shifts to stay on screen, closes on Escape, an outside press or focus leaving. variant="confirm" asks a yes/no question beside the control that was pressed. Declarative openers: data-open="#id", data-toggle and data-close work without any script (installed when the element connects).

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Enum values | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Open` | `bool` |  | attribute `open` | Whether the panel is shown. |
| `OpenChanged` | `EventCallback<bool>` |  | two-way pair of `Open` | Raised when Open changes (two-way binding: `@bind-Open`). |
| `Placement` | `string?` |  | attribute `placement` | Preferred side. |
| `Trigger` | `PopoverTrigger` | `Click` `Hover` `Manual` | attribute `trigger` | What opens it. |
| `Heading` | `string?` |  | attribute `heading` | Panel title. |
| `Label` | `string?` |  | attribute `label` | Accessible name when there is no heading. |
| `Variant` | `PopoverVariant` | `Default` `Confirm` | attribute `variant` | confirm adds Cancel and Confirm buttons. |
| `Message` | `string?` |  | attribute `message` | Body text for the confirm variant. |
| `ConfirmLabel` | `string?` |  | attribute `confirm-label` | Confirm button text. |
| `CancelLabel` | `string?` |  | attribute `cancel-label` | Cancel button text. |
| `Danger` | `bool` |  | attribute `danger` | Styles Confirm as destructive. |
| `TriggerContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `trigger` | The control that opens it. |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | default slot | Panel body. |
| `OnOpen` | `EventCallback` |  | event `pk-open` | Panel opened. |
| `OnClose` | `EventCallback<PkCloseEventArgs>` |  | event `pk-close` | Panel closed (escape, outside, cancel, confirm, toggle). |
| `OnConfirm` | `EventCallback` |  | event `pk-confirm` | Confirm pressed (variant confirm). |

Two-way binding: `@bind-Open`.

When you set a named fragment (`TriggerContent`), write the body as an explicit `<ChildContent>` tag too: Razor does not allow an implicit body next to a named fragment.

**Event args**

| Event | Args class | Fields |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-close` | `PkCloseEventArgs` | Reason: string? |

## `PkTooltip`

`<pk-tooltip>`: **Tooltip** (Overlays). A short label for the control it wraps, shown on hover, on keyboard focus and on a touch long press. Placed beside the target and flipped when it would leave the screen.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Enum values | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Text` | `string?` |  | attribute `text` | The label. |
| `TooltipContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `content` | Rich tip content in place of text. |
| `LinksContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `links` | Links shown under the panel text (a doc link, a more link). |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | default slot | The element the tip describes. |
| `Placement` | `PkTooltipPlacement` | `Top` `Bottom` `Left` `Right` | attribute `placement` | Preferred side; flips when it does not fit. |
| `HoverDelay` | `int` |  | attribute `delay` | Mouse hover delay; focus is immediate. |
| `Help` | `bool` |  | attribute `help` | Draws its own info button as the target (the default slot then holds text that follows it). |
| `Enrich` | `bool` |  | attribute `enrich` | Underlines the wrapped value with a dotted line to show it has context. |
| `Title` | `string?` |  | attribute `heading` | A bold heading inside the panel. |

When you set a named fragment (`TooltipContent`, `LinksContent`), write the body as an explicit `<ChildContent>` tag too: Razor does not allow an implicit body next to a named fragment.

**Not available as parameters** (they do not exist; do not use them)

| Parameter | Why |
|---|---|
| `DocLink` | wrapper behaviour, not a property of the element (The element has no link props: links are your own anchors in the links slot (LinksContent), where you choose the text and target.) |
| `ExternalLink` | wrapper behaviour, not a property of the element (As DocLink.) |
| `LoadAsync` | wrapper behaviour, not a property of the element (Needs component state and an async load run on the first pk-show, and no mapped parameter exposes that event; it would be a hand-written component. Render the content yourself and set it from a handler.) |
| `OnClick` | wrapper behaviour, not a property of the element (The element has no click event; put a click handler on the element you wrap.) |

Element details (parts, CSS custom properties, methods, accessibility): `pk-tooltip` in the `plainkit-sdk` skill.
